dedupe_keys.name: eries pollutant reintroduction investigation for occupational risk reduction a benchmark

description: ERIES publishes an experimental benchmark for pollutant re-entry into a mechanically ventilated building. A 1:40 model was tested at Eindhoven with thirteen wind directions and three speeds, producing thirty-nine wind conditions. The provider describes internal concentration mapping and measurements at forty ventilation inlets. These observations assess numerical dispersion and ventilation simulations. Cost and present file access are unverified. Caveats: Laboratory concentrations, scaling and occupational-risk interpretations were not independently tested.
